item: Portability legs run four xdist workers; hang, slow and fail reports armed in each worker
summary: Windows shard 2 took 5,137 s in one process (3.7x its Linux cost; time spread over file-heavy tests, not one slow test), so Windows legs met their 90-minute cap. The legs now run -n 4 --dist loadfile with the fixed placement. The report settings, taken out of the environment at import, now reach workers through workerinput; each worker writes name.gwN, the controller none, and the CI step prints them all.
